notes.title: Version 2 Update!
notes.content:
Been a while huh?

Thought it was about time I update this game with some fixes and general improvements!

[b]New Changes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] New Main Menu
[*] Music Que Fixes
[*] Spanish Localization
[*] Updated UI Elements
[/list]

That's pretty much it for now, hope you all enjoy this update!
Not sure when I'll update this again, so in the mean time have a good day and I'll see ya when I see ya!
